_README: WHERE THE EXTERNAL ANCHOR OPPONENTS LIVE ON THIS BOX.
Read by src/main/anchors/config.py; every value is overridable by an env var (the env var
name for each key is printed by `python -m main.anchors --show-config`). This file exists
because `src/utils/paths_test.py` forbids a /home/... literal anywhere under src/ — an
absolute path that is TRUE ON ONE BOX belongs in a config, not in a module.
Neither checkout is inside this repo and neither is ours to pin: record the commit that
answered, which `python -m main.anchors` does on every row it writes.
